   "source": [
    "# Control Analysis: Plant Modeling from Measured Response\n",
    "\n",
    "[![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/tatsuki-washimi/gwexpy/blob/main/docs/web/en/user_guide/tutorials/advanced_control_modeling.ipynb)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "419e3d5d",
   "metadata": {
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 0.006097,
     "end_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:19.277591+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:19.271494+00:00",

     "lang-en"
    ]
   },
   "source": [
    "This notebook promotes the legacy system-identification example into the public tutorial set. The modeling step matters because a controller should be designed against the part of the response that is both **physically meaningful** and **measured with high coherence**.\n",
    "\n",
    "We regenerate a resonant plant, estimate its transfer function, select a trustworthy frequency range, and fit a compact second-order model."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "3268e2b8",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-05T15:27:19.303516Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-05T15:27:19.303192Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.575720Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.571771Z"
    },
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 11.278798,
     "end_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.576858+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:19.298060+00:00",
     "status": "completed"
    },
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "/home/runner/micromamba/envs/gwexpy/lib/python3.11/site-packages/scipy/signal/_ltisys.py:603: BadCoefficients: Badly conditioned filter coefficients (numerator): the results may be meaningless\n",

   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import scipy.signal as signal\n",
    "from control.matlab import bode, tf\n",
    "from scipy.optimize import curve_fit\n",
    "\n",
    "from gwexpy import TimeSeries\n",
    "\n",
    "fs = 1024\n",
    "duration = 60\n",
    "t = np.arange(0, duration, 1 / fs)\n",
    "\n",
    "f0_true = 10.0\n",
    "Q_true = 10.0\n",
    "w0_true = 2 * np.pi * f0_true\n",
    "num_true = [w0_true**2]\n",
    "den_true = [1, w0_true / Q_true, w0_true**2]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Broadband excitation plus measured output recreates the experimental data that a control engineer would actually fit.\n",
    "np.random.seed(42)\n",
    "u_vals = np.random.randn(len(t))\n",
    "sys_dt = signal.cont2discrete((num_true, den_true), 1 / fs)\n",
    "y_vals = signal.dlti(sys_dt[0], sys_dt[1], dt=1 / fs).output(u_vals, t=t)[1].flatten()\n",
    "\n",
    "u = TimeSeries(u_vals, times=t, unit=\"V\", name=\"Input\")\n",
    "y = TimeSeries(y_vals, times=t, unit=\"m\", name=\"Output\")\n",
    "\n",
    "fftlength = 4\n",
    "tf_meas = y.transfer_function(u, fftlength=fftlength)\n",
    "coh = y.coherence(u, fftlength=fftlength)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9fc30e05",
   "metadata": {
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 0.006196,
     "end_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.589842+00:00",

     "start_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.583646+00:00",
     "status": "completed"

     "lang-en"
    ]
   },
   "source": [
    "## 1. Keep only the physically trustworthy band\n",
    "\n",
    "A good model fit uses frequencies where the plant dominates and the measurement is coherent. Low-coherence points usually indicate noise domination or unmodeled dynamics."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "8f65fd77",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.620892Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.620555Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.640552Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.638858Z"
    },
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 0.036874,
     "end_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.645623+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.608749+00:00",
     "status": "completed"
    },
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Selected 797 frequency points for fitting.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "freqs = tf_meas.frequencies.value\n",
    "mask = (freqs >= 1) & (freqs <= 200) & (coh.value >= 0.9)\n",
    "\n",
    "f_fit = freqs[mask]\n",
    "data_fit = tf_meas.value[mask]\n",
    "print(f\"Selected {len(f_fit)} frequency points for fitting.\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e0141ffd",
   "metadata": {
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 0.009883,
     "end_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.661073+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.651190+00:00",
     "status": "completed"
    },
    "tags": [
     "lang-en"
    ]
   },
   "source": [
    "## 2. Fit a resonator model\n",
    "\n",
    "The fitted parameters have direct physical meaning: gain sets actuation scale, `f0` gives the resonance frequency, and `Q` gives the damping width."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "74633949",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.697698Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.697417Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.729986Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.727953Z"
    },
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 0.047936,
     "end_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.732767+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.684831+00:00",
     "status": "completed"
    },
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "K=72.019, f0=189.380 Hz, Q=5.665\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "def model_mag(f, K, f0, Q):\n",
    "    w = 2 * np.pi * f\n",
    "    w0 = 2 * np.pi * f0\n",
    "    return np.abs(K * (w0**2) / ((w0**2) - (w**2) + 1j * w * w0 / Q))\n",
    "\n",
    "popt, _ = curve_fit(model_mag, f_fit, np.abs(data_fit), p0=[1.0, 10.0, 8.0])\n",
    "K_fit, f0_fit, Q_fit = popt\n",
    "print(f\"K={K_fit:.3f}, f0={f0_fit:.3f} Hz, Q={Q_fit:.3f}\")\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "3c18bd99",
   "metadata": {
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 0.01043,
     "end_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.754619+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.744189+00:00",
     "status": "completed"
    },
    "tags": [
     "lang-en"
    ]
   },
   "source": [
    "## 3. Compare the fitted model with the measurement\n",
    "\n",
    "A credible plant model should match both the peak location and the width of the measured resonance, not just one point on the curve."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "75b2be1f",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.805515Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.804756Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-07-05T15:27:32.554769Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-07-05T15:27:32.551053Z"
    },
    "papermill": {
     "duration": 1.770067,
     "end_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:32.558441+00:00",
     "exception": false,
     "start_time": "2026-07-05T15:27:30.788374+00:00",
     "status": "completed"
    },
    "tags": []
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x800 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Plot size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "w0_fit = 2 * np.pi * f0_fit\n",
    "sys_fit = tf([K_fit * w0_fit**2], [1, w0_fit / Q_fit, w0_fit**2])\n",
    "mag_fit, phase_fit, _ = bode(sys_fit, freqs, plot=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, sharex=True, figsize=(10, 8))\n",
    "tf_meas.abs().plot(ax=ax1, label=\"Measurement\", alpha=0.6)\n",
    "ax1.loglog(freqs, mag_fit, \"r--\", label=\"Fitted Model\")\n",
    "ax1.set_ylabel(\"Magnitude\")\n",
    "ax1.legend()\n",
    "ax1.grid(True, which=\"both\", alpha=0.5)\n",
    "\n",
    "phase_meas_deg = np.rad2deg(np.angle(tf_meas.value))\n",
    "ax2.semilogx(freqs, phase_meas_deg, label=\"Measurement\", alpha=0.6)\n",
    "ax2.semilogx(freqs, np.rad2deg(phase_fit), \"r--\", label=\"Fitted Model\")\n",
    "ax2.set_ylabel(\"Phase [deg]\")\n",
    "ax2.set_xlabel(\"Frequency [Hz]\")\n",
    "ax2.legend()\n",
    "ax2.grid(True, which=\"both\", alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  }
